reasoning: The evidence shows China's youth unemployment rate (ages 16-24, excluding students) was 16.5% in December 2025, down from 16.9% in November. The rate has declined for four consecutive months from a peak of 18.9% in August 2025. However, it remains above the 15% threshold. The question asks if the rate will fall below 15% in any monthly report released by July 31, 2026. Given the downward trend (2.4 percentage points decline in 4 months), reaching below 15% would require continued improvement. However, seasonal patterns show summer months typically see increases due to graduate entry. The rate needs to drop another 1.5+ percentage points. While the trend is positive, structural challenges persist, and summer 2026 will bring 12.7 million new graduates, historically causing rate spikes. The probability of breaking below 15% by July 2026 is modest but non-negligible given current momentum.
